name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, captivated by the roar of engines at the Spa-Francorchamps circuit. This fascination led her to pursue a degree in materials engineering, specializing in composite materials. After graduating, she honed her skills at a small aerospace firm before transitioning to motorsport, initially working on aerodynamic components for a Formula 3 team.

Her meticulous approach to composite layup and repair quickly earned her recognition. Elise thrives in high-pressure environments, meticulously ensuring every component meets stringent performance and safety standards. She is particularly skilled in carbon fiber fabrication and resin infusion techniques, consistently seeking innovative solutions to improve structural integrity and reduce weight. Her dedication to perfection and a relentless pursuit of improvement make her a valuable asset to Kosmic Kart.

Elise's ability to blend theoretical knowledge with practical application sets her apart. She consistently pushes the boundaries of material science within the constraints of motorsport regulations. Her goal is to push the limits of composite technology to improve performance for Kosmic Kart.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elise is of average height with a lean build, often seen with safety glasses perched atop her head.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an impossibly fine point.
Has a specific playlist of electronic music she listens to while working on intricate layup processes.
Insists on using only Belgian chocolate as a reward for finishing complex projects.
